title: How much does each thing cost?
prompt: Place each item by its approximate US price, cheapest to priciest.

items.label: A cup of coffee
items.fact: Café prices vary widely, but a plain brewed coffee lands near $4 in much of the US.

items.label: A new smartphone
items.fact: Flagship phones now cost about as much as a used laptop.

items.label: A used car
